#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
The History of Books: From Manuscripts to Mass Production
A1 Portrait Data Poster - Ink & Enlightenment Design Philosophy
Final Masterpiece Edition
"""

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Circle, FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

# A1 dimensions at 300 DPI
A1_WIDTH_INCHES = 23.39
A1_HEIGHT_INCHES = 33.07

# Refined color palette - Ink & Enlightenment
PARCHMENT = '#F7EBD9'
PARCHMENT_DARK = '#EAD9C4'
PARCHMENT_DEEP = '#DCC9AF'
AGED_INK = '#2A1810'
IRON_GALL = '#4A3428'
BURNT_ORANGE = '#B85620'
DEEP_RED = '#7A2200'
WARM_GRAY = '#6B5B4F'
LIGHT_BROWN = '#8B7355'
CREAM = '#FDF8F0'
ACCENT_GOLD = '#C49A3C'

def create_poster():
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(A1_WIDTH_INCHES, A1_HEIGHT_INCHES), dpi=300)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)

    # Grid layout: title, content rows, footer
    gs = GridSpec(5, 5, figure=fig,
                  left=0.06, right=0.96, top=0.94, bottom=0.05,
                  hspace=0.06, wspace=0.06)

    # ============================================
    # TITLE AREA - Commanding Presence
    # ============================================
    ax_title = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
    ax_title.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_title.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_title.axis('off')
    ax_title.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)

    # Top decorative bar - authoritative
    ax_title.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0.88), 1, 0.12,
                                  transform=ax_title.transAxes,
                                  facecolor=AGED_INK, edgecolor='none'))

    # Accent stripe - burnt orange
    ax_title.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0.86), 1, 0.02,
                                  transform=ax_title.transAxes,
                                  facecolor=BURNT_ORANGE, edgecolor='none'))

    # Main title - elegant, commanding
    ax_title.text(0.5, 0.62, 'THE HISTORY OF BOOKS',
                  fontsize=54, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                  fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
                  ha='center', va='center', transform=ax_title.transAxes)

    # Subtitle
    ax_title.text(0.5, 0.38, 'From Manuscripts to Mass Production',
                  fontsize=24, fontfamily='Jura',
                  fontweight='light', color=IRON_GALL,
                  ha='center', va='center', transform=ax_title.transAxes)

    # Elegant divider line
    ax_title.plot([0.32, 0.68], [0.24, 0.24], color=BURNT_ORANGE,
                  linewidth=2, transform=ax_title.transAxes)

    # Date span
    ax_title.text(0.5, 0.10, 'A Data Chronicle  ·  1,500 Years  ·  6th–21st Century',
                  fontsize=11, fontfamily='Jura',
                  color=WARM_GRAY, ha='center', va='center',
                  transform=ax_title.transAxes, style='italic')

    # ============================================
    # ROW 1: Three columns
    # ============================================

    # --- MANUSCRIPT ERA (col 0) ---
    ax_ms = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
    ax_ms.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)
    ax_ms.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_ms.set_ylim(0, 1)

    # Roman numeral
    ax_ms.text(0.5, 0.97, 'I', fontsize=14, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
               fontweight='bold', color=BURNT_ORANGE,
               ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_ms.transAxes)
    ax_ms.text(0.5, 0.90, 'THE MANUSCRIPT ERA',
               fontsize=9, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
               fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
               ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_ms.transAxes)
    ax_ms.text(0.5, 0.83, '6th–15th Century',
               fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura',
               color=WARM_GRAY, ha='center', va='top',
               transform=ax_ms.transAxes)

    # Horizontal bar chart for manuscript growth
    centuries = ['6th', '9th', '12th', '14th', '15th']
    manuscripts = [1, 8, 28, 55, 70]

    y_positions = np.linspace(0.68, 0.28, 5)
    for i, (c, m) in enumerate(zip(centuries, manuscripts)):
        # Bar
        ax_ms.add_patch(Rectangle((0.18, y_positions[i] - 0.03),
                                   m/70 * 0.52, 0.06,
                                   transform=ax_ms.transAxes,
                                   facecolor=IRON_GALL, edgecolor='none'))
        # Label
        ax_ms.text(0.14, y_positions[i], c,
                   fontsize=6, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
                   ha='right', va='center', transform=ax_ms.transAxes)

    # Annotation
    ax_ms.text(0.5, 0.08, 'Slow accumulation\nover a millennium',
               fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
               ha='center', va='bottom', transform=ax_ms.transAxes,
               style='italic', linespacing=1.4)

    # --- GUTENBERG REVOLUTION (cols 1-3) - THE DOMINANT FEATURE ---
    ax_rev = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:4])
    ax_rev.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)
    ax_rev.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_rev.set_ylim(0, 1)

    # Roman numeral
    ax_rev.text(0.5, 0.97, 'II', fontsize=14, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=BURNT_ORANGE,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_rev.transAxes)
    ax_rev.text(0.5, 0.90, 'THE GUTENBERG REVOLUTION',
                fontsize=11, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_rev.transAxes)
    ax_rev.text(0.5, 0.83, '~1440',
                fontsize=9, fontfamily='Jura',
                color=BURNT_ORANGE, ha='center', va='top',
                transform=ax_rev.transAxes)

    # Timeline data - THE VISUAL HEART
    time_points = [500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1000, 1100, 1200, 1300, 1400, 1450,
                   1500, 1550, 1600, 1700, 1750, 1800, 1850, 1900, 1950, 2000]
    production = [2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 20, 35, 50, 65,
                  200, 400, 650, 900, 1200, 2200, 4500, 8500, 14000, 20000]

    x_vals = np.arange(len(time_points))
    ax_rev.fill_between(x_vals, production, alpha=0.2, color=BURNT_ORANGE)
    ax_rev.plot(x_vals, production, color=BURNT_ORANGE, linewidth=3.5)

    # Gutenberg annotation - DRAMATIC
    gut_idx = 10
    ax_rev.annotate('',
                    xy=(gut_idx, production[gut_idx]),
                    xytext=(gut_idx, production[gut_idx] + 4000),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=DEEP_RED, lw=2.5))
    ax_rev.text(gut_idx + 0.3, production[gut_idx] + 4500,
                'GUTENBERG',
                fontsize=11, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=DEEP_RED,
                ha='left', va='bottom', transform=ax_rev.transAxes)
    ax_rev.text(gut_idx + 0.3, production[gut_idx] + 2800,
                '~1440',
                fontsize=9, fontfamily='Jura',
                color=DEEP_RED, ha='left', va='bottom',
                transform=ax_rev.transAxes)

    # Era divider
    ax_rev.axvline(x=10.5, color=AGED_INK, linestyle=':', linewidth=1, alpha=0.5)

    # Era labels
    ax_rev.text(5, 19000, 'Manuscript Era',
                fontsize=8, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_rev.transAxes,
                style='italic')
    ax_rev.text(16, 19000, 'Era of Print',
                fontsize=8, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_rev.transAxes,
                style='italic')

    # Axis
    ax_rev.set_xticks([0, 5, 10, 15, 20])
    ax_rev.set_xticklabels(['500', '1000', '1450', '1800', '2000'],
                           fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY)
    ax_rev.set_yticks([])
    ax_rev.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax_rev.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax_rev.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
    ax_rev.spines['bottom'].set_color(PARCHMENT_DARK)
    ax_rev.tick_params(length=0)

    # Dramatic stat callout
    ax_rev.text(0.84, 0.22, '400×',
                fontsize=32, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=DEEP_RED,
                ha='center', va='center', transform=ax_rev.transAxes)
    ax_rev.text(0.84, 0.12, 'increase in two centuries',
                fontsize=9, fontfamily='Jura',
                color=WARM_GRAY, ha='center', va='top',
                transform=ax_rev.transAxes)

    # --- MODERN ERA (col 4) ---
    ax_mod = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 4])
    ax_mod.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)
    ax_mod.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_mod.set_ylim(0, 1)

    ax_mod.text(0.5, 0.97, 'III', fontsize=14, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=BURNT_ORANGE,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_mod.transAxes)
    ax_mod.text(0.5, 0.90, 'MODERN ERA',
                fontsize=9, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_mod.transAxes)
    ax_mod.text(0.5, 0.83, 'Per Capita',
                fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura',
                color=WARM_GRAY, ha='center', va='top',
                transform=ax_mod.transAxes)

    # Per capita chart
    nations = ['Norway', 'Iceland', 'Denmark', 'Sweden', 'Global', 'India', 'China']
    per_capita = [500, 450, 400, 380, 100, 50, 25]

    x_starts = np.linspace(0.12, 0.78, 7)
    for i, val in enumerate(per_capita):
        col = BURNT_ORANGE if i < 4 else IRON_GALL
        bar_h = val/500 * 0.48
        ax_mod.add_patch(Rectangle((x_starts[i], 0.15), 0.06, bar_h,
                                   transform=ax_mod.transAxes,
                                   facecolor=col, edgecolor='none'))
        if i == 4:
            ax_mod.plot([x_starts[i], x_starts[i] + 0.06], [0.14, 0.14],
                       color=DEEP_RED, linewidth=2,
                       transform=ax_mod.transAxes)

    ax_mod.text(0.5, 0.06, 'Titles per Million',
                fontsize=6, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
                ha='center', va='bottom', transform=ax_mod.transAxes,
                style='italic')

    # ============================================
    # ROW 2: Mirror of Society + Metrics
    # ============================================

    # --- BOOKS AS MIRROR OF SOCIETY (cols 0-2) ---
    ax_mirror = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0:3])
    ax_mirror.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)
    ax_mirror.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_mirror.set_ylim(0, 1)

    ax_mirror.text(0.02, 0.95, 'IV',
                   fontsize=14, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                   fontweight='bold', color=BURNT_ORANGE,
                   ha='left', va='top', transform=ax_mirror.transAxes)
    ax_mirror.text(0.06, 0.95, 'BOOKS AS A MIRROR OF SOCIETY',
                   fontsize=11, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                   fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
                   ha='left', va='top', transform=ax_mirror.transAxes)

    # Four proxy indicators - elegantly spaced
    proxy_data = [
        ('LITERACY', 'Higher book output correlates\nwith greater population literacy', BURNT_ORANGE),
        ('WEALTH', 'Affordable books signal\nrising prosperity', DEEP_RED),
        ('EDUCATION', 'Expanding schools drive\ndemand for published material', IRON_GALL),
        ('CULTURE', 'From religious texts to secular\nworks over centuries', WARM_GRAY),
    ]

    x_pos = 0.08
    spacing = 0.235
    for i, (proxy, desc, col) in enumerate(proxy_data):
        # Circle
        ax_mirror.add_patch(Circle((x_pos + 0.015, 0.60), 0.028,
                                   transform=ax_mirror.transAxes,
                                   facecolor=col, edgecolor='none'))
        # Label
        ax_mirror.text(x_pos + 0.05, 0.60, proxy,
                       fontsize=9, fontfamily='Jura',
                       fontweight='bold', color=col,
                       ha='left', va='center',
                       transform=ax_mirror.transAxes)
        # Description
        ax_mirror.text(x_pos + 0.05, 0.45, desc,
                       fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura',
                       color=WARM_GRAY, ha='left', va='top',
                       transform=ax_mirror.transAxes,
                       linespacing=1.3)
        x_pos += spacing

    # --- KEY METRICS (cols 3-4) ---
    ax_key = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 3:5])
    ax_key.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)
    ax_key.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_key.set_ylim(0, 1)

    ax_key.text(0.5, 0.95, 'KEY METRICS',
               fontsize=10, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
               fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
               ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_key.transAxes)

    metrics_data = [
        ('~1440', "Gutenberg's\nPress Invented"),
        ('10', 'Centuries of\nManuscript Era'),
        ('400×', 'Print Growth\n1450–1650'),
        ('>49', 'UNESCO Book\nPage Definition'),
    ]

    box_spacing = 0.245
    start_x = 0.03
    for i, (val, label) in enumerate(metrics_data):
        x = start_x + i * box_spacing

        ax_key.text(x + 0.10, 0.68, val,
                    fontsize=20, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                    fontweight='bold', color=BURNT_ORANGE,
                    ha='center', va='center', transform=ax_key.transAxes)

        ax_key.text(x + 0.10, 0.42, label,
                    fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura',
                    color=WARM_GRAY, ha='center', va='top',
                    transform=ax_key.transAxes,
                    linespacing=1.3)

        ax_key.plot([x, x + 0.20], [0.28, 0.28],
                    color=PARCHMENT_DEEP, linewidth=1,
                    transform=ax_key.transAxes)

    # ============================================
    # FOOTER AREA
    # ============================================
    ax_footer = fig.add_subplot(gs[3:, :])
    ax_footer.set_facecolor(AGED_INK)
    ax_footer.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_footer.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_footer.axis('off')

    # Accent stripe at top of footer
    ax_footer.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0.82), 1, 0.18,
                                   transform=ax_footer.transAxes,
                                   facecolor=BURNT_ORANGE, edgecolor='none'))

    # Sources
    ax_footer.text(0.5, 0.60,
                  'Sources: Buringh & Van Zanden (2009) · Fink-Jensen (2015) · Our World in Data',
                  fontsize=8, fontfamily='Jura', color=CREAM,
                  ha='center', va='center', transform=ax_footer.transAxes)

    # Closing statement - the narrative beat
    ax_footer.text(0.5, 0.28,
                  'The transition from manuscripts to printed books — and from elite luxury to mass commodity —\n'
                  'is one of the most important stories in the history of human knowledge.',
                  fontsize=9, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                  color=CREAM, ha='center', va='center',
                  transform=ax_footer.transAxes, style='italic',
                  linespacing=1.5)

    # ============================================
    # DECORATIVE - LEFT VERTICAL ACCENT
    # ============================================
    ax_left = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])
    ax_left.set_facecolor(AGED_INK)
    ax_left.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_left.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_left.axis('off')

    # Orange stripe
    ax_left.add_patch(Rectangle((0.75, 0), 0.25, 1,
                                 transform=ax_left.transAxes,
                                 facecolor=BURNT_ORANGE, edgecolor='none'))

    # ============================================
    # SAVE
    # ============================================
    plt.savefig('/app/output/final_poster.png', dpi=300,
                facecolor=PARCHMENT, edgecolor='none')
    plt.close()

    print("Masterpiece poster saved: /app/output/final_poster.png")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    create_poster()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
The History of Books: From Manuscripts to Mass Production
A1 Portrait Data Poster - Ink & Enlightenment Design Philosophy
Final Masterpiece Edition
"""

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle, Circle, FancyBboxPatch
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
import matplotlib.patheffects as pe

# A1 dimensions at 300 DPI
A1_WIDTH_INCHES = 23.39
A1_HEIGHT_INCHES = 33.07

# Refined color palette - Ink & Enlightenment
PARCHMENT = '#F7EBD9'
PARCHMENT_DARK = '#EAD9C4'
PARCHMENT_DEEP = '#DCC9AF'
AGED_INK = '#2A1810'
IRON_GALL = '#4A3428'
BURNT_ORANGE = '#B85620'
DEEP_RED = '#7A2200'
WARM_GRAY = '#6B5B4F'
LIGHT_BROWN = '#8B7355'
CREAM = '#FDF8F0'
ACCENT_GOLD = '#C49A3C'

def create_poster():
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(A1_WIDTH_INCHES, A1_HEIGHT_INCHES), dpi=300)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)

    # Grid layout: title, content rows, footer
    gs = GridSpec(5, 5, figure=fig,
                  left=0.06, right=0.96, top=0.94, bottom=0.05,
                  hspace=0.06, wspace=0.06)

    # ============================================
    # TITLE AREA - Commanding Presence
    # ============================================
    ax_title = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
    ax_title.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_title.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_title.axis('off')
    ax_title.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)

    # Top decorative bar - authoritative
    ax_title.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0.88), 1, 0.12,
                                  transform=ax_title.transAxes,
                                  facecolor=AGED_INK, edgecolor='none'))

    # Accent stripe - burnt orange
    ax_title.add_patch(Rectangle((0, 0.86), 1, 0.02,
                                  transform=ax_title.transAxes,
                                  facecolor=BURNT_ORANGE, edgecolor='none'))

    # Main title - elegant, commanding
    ax_title.text(0.5, 0.62, 'THE HISTORY OF BOOKS',
                  fontsize=54, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                  fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
                  ha='center', va='center', transform=ax_title.transAxes)

    # Subtitle
    ax_title.text(0.5, 0.38, 'From Manuscripts to Mass Production',
                  fontsize=24, fontfamily='Jura',
                  fontweight='light', color=IRON_GALL,
                  ha='center', va='center', transform=ax_title.transAxes)

    # Elegant divider line
    ax_title.plot([0.32, 0.68], [0.24, 0.24], color=BURNT_ORANGE,
                  linewidth=2, transform=ax_title.transAxes)

    # Date span
    ax_title.text(0.5, 0.10, 'A Data Chronicle  ·  1,500 Years  ·  6th–21st Century',
                  fontsize=11, fontfamily='Jura',
                  color=WARM_GRAY, ha='center', va='center',
                  transform=ax_title.transAxes, style='italic')

    # ============================================
    # ROW 1: Three columns
    # ============================================

    # --- MANUSCRIPT ERA (col 0) ---
    ax_ms = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
    ax_ms.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)
    ax_ms.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_ms.set_ylim(0, 1)

    # Roman numeral
    ax_ms.text(0.5, 0.97, 'I', fontsize=14, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
               fontweight='bold', color=BURNT_ORANGE,
               ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_ms.transAxes)
    ax_ms.text(0.5, 0.90, 'THE MANUSCRIPT ERA',
               fontsize=9, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
               fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
               ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_ms.transAxes)
    ax_ms.text(0.5, 0.83, '6th–15th Century',
               fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura',
               color=WARM_GRAY, ha='center', va='top',
               transform=ax_ms.transAxes)

    # Horizontal bar chart for manuscript growth
    centuries = ['6th', '9th', '12th', '14th', '15th']
    manuscripts = [1, 8, 28, 55, 70]

    y_positions = np.linspace(0.68, 0.28, 5)
    for i, (c, m) in enumerate(zip(centuries, manuscripts)):
        # Bar
        ax_ms.add_patch(Rectangle((0.18, y_positions[i] - 0.03),
                                   m/70 * 0.52, 0.06,
                                   transform=ax_ms.transAxes,
                                   facecolor=IRON_GALL, edgecolor='none'))
        # Label
        ax_ms.text(0.14, y_positions[i], c,
                   fontsize=6, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
                   ha='right', va='center', transform=ax_ms.transAxes)

    # Annotation
    ax_ms.text(0.5, 0.08, 'Slow accumulation\nover a millennium',
               fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
               ha='center', va='bottom', transform=ax_ms.transAxes,
               style='italic', linespacing=1.4)

    # --- GUTENBERG REVOLUTION (cols 1-3) - THE DOMINANT FEATURE ---
    ax_rev = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1:4])
    ax_rev.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)
    ax_rev.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_rev.set_ylim(0, 1)

    # Roman numeral
    ax_rev.text(0.5, 0.97, 'II', fontsize=14, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=BURNT_ORANGE,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_rev.transAxes)
    ax_rev.text(0.5, 0.90, 'THE GUTENBERG REVOLUTION',
                fontsize=11, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_rev.transAxes)
    ax_rev.text(0.5, 0.83, '~1440',
                fontsize=9, fontfamily='Jura',
                color=BURNT_ORANGE, ha='center', va='top',
                transform=ax_rev.transAxes)

    # Timeline data - THE VISUAL HEART
    time_points = [500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1000, 1100, 1200, 1300, 1400, 1450,
                   1500, 1550, 1600, 1700, 1750, 1800, 1850, 1900, 1950, 2000]
    production = [2, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 20, 35, 50, 65,
                  200, 400, 650, 900, 1200, 2200, 4500, 8500, 14000, 20000]

    x_vals = np.arange(len(time_points))
    ax_rev.fill_between(x_vals, production, alpha=0.2, color=BURNT_ORANGE)
    ax_rev.plot(x_vals, production, color=BURNT_ORANGE, linewidth=3.5)

    # Gutenberg annotation - DRAMATIC
    gut_idx = 10
    ax_rev.annotate('',
                    xy=(gut_idx, production[gut_idx]),
                    xytext=(gut_idx, production[gut_idx] + 4000),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=DEEP_RED, lw=2.5))
    ax_rev.text(gut_idx + 0.3, production[gut_idx] + 4500,
                'GUTENBERG',
                fontsize=11, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=DEEP_RED,
                ha='left', va='bottom', transform=ax_rev.transAxes)
    ax_rev.text(gut_idx + 0.3, production[gut_idx] + 2800,
                '~1440',
                fontsize=9, fontfamily='Jura',
                color=DEEP_RED, ha='left', va='bottom',
                transform=ax_rev.transAxes)

    # Era divider
    ax_rev.axvline(x=10.5, color=AGED_INK, linestyle=':', linewidth=1, alpha=0.5)

    # Era labels
    ax_rev.text(5, 19000, 'Manuscript Era',
                fontsize=8, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_rev.transAxes,
                style='italic')
    ax_rev.text(16, 19000, 'Era of Print',
                fontsize=8, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_rev.transAxes,
                style='italic')

    # Axis
    ax_rev.set_xticks([0, 5, 10, 15, 20])
    ax_rev.set_xticklabels(['500', '1000', '1450', '1800', '2000'],
                           fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY)
    ax_rev.set_yticks([])
    ax_rev.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax_rev.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax_rev.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
    ax_rev.spines['bottom'].set_color(PARCHMENT_DARK)
    ax_rev.tick_params(length=0)

    # Dramatic stat callout
    ax_rev.text(0.84, 0.22, '400×',
                fontsize=32, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=DEEP_RED,
                ha='center', va='center', transform=ax_rev.transAxes)
    ax_rev.text(0.84, 0.12, 'increase in two centuries',
                fontsize=9, fontfamily='Jura',
                color=WARM_GRAY, ha='center', va='top',
                transform=ax_rev.transAxes)

    # --- MODERN ERA (col 4) ---
    ax_mod = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 4])
    ax_mod.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)
    ax_mod.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_mod.set_ylim(0, 1)

    ax_mod.text(0.5, 0.97, 'III', fontsize=14, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=BURNT_ORANGE,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_mod.transAxes)
    ax_mod.text(0.5, 0.90, 'MODERN ERA',
                fontsize=9, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
                ha='center', va='top', transform=ax_mod.transAxes)
    ax_mod.text(0.5, 0.83, 'Per Capita',
                fontsize=7, fontfamily='Jura',
                color=WARM_GRAY, ha='center', va='top',
                transform=ax_mod.transAxes)

    # Per capita chart
    nations = ['Norway', 'Iceland', 'Denmark', 'Sweden', 'Global', 'India', 'China']
    per_capita = [500, 450, 400, 380, 100, 50, 25]

    x_starts = np.linspace(0.12, 0.78, 7)
    for i, val in enumerate(per_capita):
        col = BURNT_ORANGE if i < 4 else IRON_GALL
        bar_h = val/500 * 0.48
        ax_mod.add_patch(Rectangle((x_starts[i], 0.15), 0.06, bar_h,
                                   transform=ax_mod.transAxes,
                                   facecolor=col, edgecolor='none'))
        if i == 4:
            ax_mod.plot([x_starts[i], x_starts[i] + 0.06], [0.14, 0.14],
                       color=DEEP_RED, linewidth=2,
                       transform=ax_mod.transAxes)

    ax_mod.text(0.5, 0.06, 'Titles per Million',
                fontsize=6, fontfamily='Jura', color=WARM_GRAY,
                ha='center', va='bottom', transform=ax_mod.transAxes,
                style='italic')

    # ============================================
    # ROW 2: Mirror of Society + Metrics
    # ============================================

    # --- BOOKS AS MIRROR OF SOCIETY (cols 0-2) ---
    ax_mirror = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0:3])
    ax_mirror.set_facecolor(PARCHMENT)
    ax_mirror.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax_mirror.set_ylim(0, 1)

    ax_mirror.text(0.02, 0.95, 'IV',
                   fontsize=14, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                   fontweight='bold', color=BURNT_ORANGE,
                   ha='left', va='top', transform=ax_mirror.transAxes)
    ax_mirror.text(0.06, 0.95, 'BOOKS AS A MIRROR OF SOCIETY',
                   fontsize=11, fontfamily='Libre Baskerville',
                   fontweight='bold', color=AGED_INK,
                   ha='left', va='top', transform=ax_mirror.transAxes)

    # Four proxy indicators - elegantly spaced
    proxy_data = [
        ('LITERACY', 'Higher book output correlates\nwith greater population literacy', BURNT_ORANGE),
        ('WEALTH', 'Affordable books signal\nrising prosperity', DEEP_RED),

"""
The History of Books: From Manuscripts to Mass Production
A1 Portrait Data Poster - Ink & Enlightenment Design Philosophy

from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec

A1_HEIGHT_INCHES = 33.07

PARCHMENT_DARK = '#EAD9C4'

IRON_GALL = '#4A3428'

    ax_rev.text(0.84, 0.12, 'increase in two centuries',

    # --- MODERN ERA (col 4) ---
    ax_mod = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 4])

    ax_left = fig.add_subplot(gs[:, 0])

    # ============================================

    plt.savefig('/app/output/final_poster.png', dpi=300,

    print("Masterpiece poster saved: /app/output/final_poster.png")
